CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.enterprise_sources (
 source_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.sources(id),revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 policy jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(policy)='object'),updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.enterprise_rate_windows (
 source_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES ultrabrain.enterprise_sources(source_id),subject text NOT NULL,
 window_start timestamptz NOT NULL,used integer NOT NULL CHECK(used>0),PRIMARY KEY(source_id,subject))

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.enterprise_audit (
 id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,request_id uuid NOT NULL,source_id text NOT NULL,
 actor_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(actor_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),operation text NOT NULL CHECK(operation ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,96}$'),
 phase text NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('admission','result','configuration')),
 outcome text NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('admitted','denied','succeeded','failed','configured')),
 code text NOT NULL CHECK(code ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$'),policy_revision integer,
 duration_ms integer CHECK(duration_ms>=0),created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 UNIQUE(request_id,phase),CHECK((phase='admission' AND outcome IN ('admitted','denied')) OR
 (phase='result' AND outcome IN ('succeeded','failed')) OR (phase='configuration' AND outcome='configured')))

CREATE FUNCTION ultrabrain.reject_audit_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $f$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'enterprise_audit is append-only; retention requires separately reviewed administration' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END $f$

CREATE TRIGGER enterprise_audit_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON ultrabrain.enterprise_audit
FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.reject_audit_mutation()
